output.description: Grants a role from an allowed set to an existing PostgreSQL user so the user gets the role's privileges on the schema, and can also let the user pass the role on to others. It first moves the user's pending access requests for that role from role_access_requests into role_access_requests_archive.
output.declaring_phrase: moves the user's pending access requests for that role from role_access_requests into role_access_requests_archive
